name: Grok Build
description: Terminal-native coding agent from xAI that launched with Grok 4.5 as its default model. Features parallel agent architecture spawning up to eight parallel sub-agents, capable of autonomous planning, file editing, command execution, and Excel model building. Competes directly with Claude Code and Codex CLI in the AI coding agent market.
community_quotes: Parallelism over depth architecture with eight parallel sub-agents
Terminal-native coding agent that plans, edits files, and runs commands autonomously
Competes in the three-way race against Claude Code and Codex CLI
v0.1 opened to external apps and tools on July 8, 2026
